decision.why: Vision transcription was best on the seven-excerpt pilot: melody error fell from 66.9% to 3.1%, chord sequence error from 78.9% to 0%, and all outputs parsed. OCR-to-harmony promotion gave no improvement. The goal remains unmet: four melody errors remain, four of seven transposition checks failed, chord timing is unaudited, musician review is absent, and the remaining 25 development excerpts were not tested with this approach. Both experiments are exhausted.
decision.hypothesis: Direct vision transcription improves pilot recognition, but reliable transposition and complete musical correctness remain unestablished.
decision.expected_observation: Retain the best evaluated pilot result without claiming completion or held-out accuracy; further work requires diagnosing transposition failures, correcting melody errors, auditing chord timing and evaluating all 32 excerpts with musician review.
